# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/client"
```

Package client is the Charging Station role of OCPP (OCPP 1.6: Charge Point): it connects to a CSMS, sends CALLs to it and answers the CALLs the CSMS sends.

```go
const (
	DefaultHandshakeTimeout = 30 * time.Second
	DefaultResponseTimeout  = 30 * time.Second
	DefaultMaxQueuedCalls   = 64
	DefaultMaxMessageSize   = 64 << 10
)
```

Defaults of the client options.

## Types

### type Client

```go
type Client struct {

	// draining is set by Shutdown: new calls fail with ErrClosed.

	// state and version are written under mu and read without it, so that
	// the state handler, which runs under mu, may read them.
	// ocpp.State
	// ocpp.Version
	// stateErr is the error of the last state change; changed is closed
	// and replaced on every state change, for Connect to wait on.

	// redial is the back-off a redial loop finishes with after
	// SetReconnect(nil); nil until then.

	// closed when the supervisor has exited; nil if none

}
```

Client is a charging station's connection to its CSMS. It is safe for concurrent use, and implements ocpp.Peer, so that the call functions of the version packages accept it.

#### func New

```go
func New(rawURL string, opts ...Option) (*Client, error)
```

New returns a client for the CSMS endpoint url. The station identity is the last path segment of url (ws\[s]://host/path/\<identity>). New does not connect; call Connect.

#### func (Client) Call

```go
func (c *Client) Call(ctx context.Context, action string, req, resp any) error
```

Call sends a CALL to the CSMS and waits for its result (see ocpp.Caller). While the client is not connected it fails at once with ocpp.ErrNotConnected; nothing is queued.

#### func (Client) Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close closes the connection and stops reconnecting. Pending calls fail with ocpp.ErrClosed. Close is idempotent. Called from a handler, it returns without waiting for that handler.

#### func (Client) Connect

```go
func (c *Client) Connect(ctx context.Context) error
```

Connect opens the connection and returns once it is open, or with an error wrapping ocpp.ErrConnectFailed. It does not retry: with WithReconnect, redialling starts only after an open connection is lost. Connect on a connected client does nothing. While another Connect, or a redial of WithReconnect, is in progress, Connect waits for it, until ctx ends: it returns nil once the connection is open, or the other Connect's error. Close ends a Connect in progress with ocpp.ErrClosed.

#### func (Client) ID

```go
func (c *Client) ID() string
```

ID returns the station identity.

#### func (Client) Role

```go
func (c *Client) Role() ocpp.Role
```

Role returns ocpp.ChargingStation. The call functions of the version packages use it to refuse an action the CSMS sends.

#### func (Client) Send

```go
func (c *Client) Send(ctx context.Context, action string, req any) error
```

Send sends a SEND to the CSMS (OCPP 2.1; see ocpp.Sender). It is never answered and does not wait for an outstanding CALL. While the client is not connected it fails at once with ocpp.ErrNotConnected.

#### func (Client) SetReconnect

```go
func (c *Client) SetReconnect(r *Reconnect) error
```

SetReconnect changes the reconnection back-off from the next attempt on: for a CSMS that sets the RetryBackOff variables of OCPPCommCtrlr (2.x) while the station runs. Nil stops reconnecting after the next loss; a reconnect already waiting finishes with the settings it had.

#### func (Client) Shutdown

```go
func (c *Client) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error
```

Shutdown stops new calls (they fail with ocpp.ErrClosed) and the dispatch of CALLs from the CSMS that have not started, waits until what is in flight is done (the calls already made have their answers, the handlers that have started have answered, and every queued frame, SENDs and answers included, is written) or until ctx ends, and then closes like Close. It returns ctx.Err() when ctx ended first; the client is closed either way. Called from a handler, it waits for that handler and so until ctx ends: close from a handler with Close, or with Shutdown in ocpp.AfterResponse.

```go
func (c *Client) State() ocpp.State
```

State returns the connection state.

#### func (Client) Version

```go
func (c *Client) Version() ocpp.Version
```

Version returns the version negotiated on the current connection, or the last one; zero before the first connection.

### type HandshakeError

```go
type HandshakeError struct {
	StatusCode int
}
```

HandshakeError is the HTTP status with which the CSMS refused the WebSocket handshake. Connect's error wraps it next to ocpp.ErrConnectFailed, so that an application can decide how to go on: 401 wrong credentials, 404 unknown identity, 409 already connected, 503 try later. A 101 whose upgrade headers are broken is not reported as one; a refused redirect from wss:// to ws:// is, with the redirect's status.

	var he *client.HandshakeError
	if errors.As(err, &he) && he.StatusCode == http.StatusUnauthorized { ... }

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*options)
```

Option configures a Client.

#### func WithBasicAuth

```go
func WithBasicAuth(username, password string) Option
```

WithBasicAuth sends HTTP Basic credentials in the opening handshake (security profiles 1 and 2). OCPP uses the station identity as the user name, which must not contain a colon (RFC 7617 §2). The password is never logged.

#### func WithCallInterceptor

```go
func WithCallInterceptor(i ocpp.Interceptor) Option
```

WithCallInterceptor wraps every outgoing CALL.

#### func WithCompression

```go
func WithCompression() Option
```

WithCompression offers WebSocket compression (RFC 7692 permessage-deflate) in the handshake. OCPP 2.x makes it optional for a charging station and recommends it, to reduce mobile data; a CSMS must support it. The message size limit applies after decompression.

#### func WithFrameObserver

```go
func WithFrameObserver(f ocpp.FrameObserver) Option
```

WithFrameObserver sees every frame sent and received.

#### func WithHTTPClient

```go
func WithHTTPClient(c *http.Client) Option
```

WithHTTPClient sets the HTTP client used for the opening handshake, for proxies or custom transports. It cannot be combined with WithTLS: configure TLS on the client's transport instead. The client uses a copy of c that also refuses a redirect from wss:// to ws://; c's CheckRedirect applies to the other redirects, and c itself is not changed. The handshake timeout and Connect's ctx bound a handshake that stalls after its response only when c's Transport is an \*http.Transport (or nil); another RoundTripper must bound its own connections.

#### func WithHandler

```go
func WithHandler(v ocpp.Version, d ocpp.Dispatcher) Option
```

WithHandler sets the dispatcher for the CSMS's CALLs on connections of version v, typically built by a version package, e.g. ocpp201.ChargingStation(h). A CALL on a version without a dispatcher is answered with NotImplemented.

#### func WithHandlerInterceptor

```go
func WithHandlerInterceptor(i ocpp.Interceptor) Option
```

WithHandlerInterceptor wraps the handling of every incoming CALL.

#### func WithHandshakeTimeout

```go
func WithHandshakeTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithHandshakeTimeout bounds the dial, TLS and WebSocket handshakes.

#### func WithHeader

```go
func WithHeader(name, value string) Option
```

WithHeader adds a header to the WebSocket handshake request, for a CSMS or a proxy in front of it that expects one (a tenant or an API key, say). It may be given more than once. Authorization (use WithBasicAuth), Host, Connection, Upgrade and the Sec-WebSocket-\* headers are set by the client and refused here.

#### func WithIncomingRateLimit

```go
func WithIncomingRateLimit(perSecond float64, burst int) Option
```

WithIncomingRateLimit dispatches at most perSecond of the CSMS's incoming CALLs and SENDs a second, in bursts of up to burst. Messages over the rate wait: none is refused, since OCPP has no error for "too many"; once the bounded incoming queue is full, reading from the connection waits too. Zero (the default) sets no limit.

#### func WithInsecureTransport

```go
func WithInsecureTransport() Option
```

WithInsecureTransport allows ws:// URLs: OCPP without TLS. Credentials and messages then cross the network in clear text (security profile 1). Use it only on closed networks and in tests.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l *slog.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger sets the logger. Without it nothing is logged.

#### func WithMaxBadMessages

```go
func WithMaxBadMessages(n int) Option
```

WithMaxBadMessages closes the connection with status 1008 once n malformed frames have been received on it. Each is still answered or dropped as the version requires. Zero (the default) sets no limit.

#### func WithMaxMessageSize

```go
func WithMaxMessageSize(n int) Option
```

WithMaxMessageSize sets the largest message accepted, in bytes. A larger one closes the connection.

#### func WithMaxQueuedCalls

```go
func WithMaxQueuedCalls(n int) Option
```

WithMaxQueuedCalls sets how many calls may wait for the outgoing slot before Call fails with ErrBusy.

#### func WithMetrics

```go
func WithMetrics(m ocpp.Metrics) Option
```

WithMetrics sets the metrics callbacks.

#### func WithPingInterval

```go
func WithPingInterval(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithPingInterval makes the client send a WebSocket ping every d, and treat the connection as lost when the pong does not arrive within d: a half-open connection is then noticed without waiting for a CALL to time out. OCPP 2.x configures it with the WebSocketPingInterval variable of OCPPCommCtrlr, OCPP 1.6 with the WebSocketPingInterval configuration key; the application passes the value in. Zero (the default) sends no pings.

#### func WithReconnect

```go
func WithReconnect(r Reconnect) Option
```

WithReconnect makes the client redial after an open connection is lost (OCPP 2.x Part 4 §5.4: a station SHALL reconnect), with the back-off r; DefaultReconnect() when the CSMS has configured none. It redials until Close. Nothing is resent: requests that were pending fail with ErrConnectionLost, and the application decides what to send again.

#### func WithResponseTimeout

```go
func WithResponseTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithResponseTimeout sets how long a CALL waits for its response.

#### func WithStateHandler

```go
func WithStateHandler(f func(state ocpp.State, err error)) Option
```

WithStateHandler sets a function called on every state change, with the error that caused it, if any. It is called synchronously and in order; it may read State, Version and ID, but must not block and must not call Close, Connect or Call.

#### func WithTLS

```go
func WithTLS(cfg *tls.Config) Option
```

WithTLS sets the TLS configuration for wss:// URLs: the trust roots (RootCAs) and, for security profile 3, the client certificate (Certificates or GetClientCertificate). The configuration is cloned, and its MinVersion raised to TLS 1.2 if it is lower.

#### func WithVersions

```go
func WithVersions(v ...ocpp.Version) Option
```

WithVersions sets the OCPP versions the client offers, in order of preference. Without it the client offers the versions it has handlers for, newest first.

#### func WithWriteTimeout

```go
func WithWriteTimeout(d time.Duration) Option
```

WithWriteTimeout bounds writing one message. A CSMS that stops reading makes the write fail, and the connection is closed as lost. Default 10 s.

### type Reconnect

```go
type Reconnect struct {
	WaitMinimum time.Duration // RetryBackOffWaitMinimum; must be positive
	RandomRange time.Duration // RetryBackOffRandomRange; zero: no randomness
	RepeatTimes int           // RetryBackOffRepeatTimes; zero: the delay never doubles
}
```

Reconnect configures automatic reconnection, with the back-off that OCPP 2.x Part 4 §5.4 requires of a charging station, configured by the device model variables of OCPPCommCtrlr that its fields are named after. The delay before reconnection attempt n (1, 2, …) is

	WaitMinimum · 2^min(n-1, RepeatTimes) + a random value in [0, RandomRange]

OCPP 1.6 defines no such variables; the same algorithm is used.

#### func DefaultReconnect

```go
func DefaultReconnect() Reconnect
```

DefaultReconnect returns reconnection settings for when the CSMS has not configured any: 5 s, plus up to 10 s at random, doubled up to 5 times (at most 160 s plus the random part). The specifications give no defaults; these are an implementation choice.
